ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the picture there are 10 identical rectangular paving stones arranged alternately in sequence, and a black broken line connects the center points of these paving stones. The black broken line goes from the first piece to the tenth piece and connects 10 center points in total, so it is composed of 9 straight segments. Observing the directions of the broken line, among them there are 5 longer diagonal segments along the long-side direction of the paving stones, and another 4 shorter descending segments along the width direction of the paving stones. Then reason: Each paving stone is 6 dm long and 4 dm wide. The 5 segments along the long-side direction are each 6 dm, for a total length of 5 × 6 = 30 dm; the 4 segments along the width direction are each 4 dm, for a total length of 4 × 4 = 16 dm. Therefore the total length of the black line is 30 + 16 = 46 dm.
